messages:
Anna (PM): Quick sync — I sketched an onboarding/checkpoint plan for private deploy customers that ask for customer-managed networking. Need to decide what we ship in MVP vs. later. TL;DR: focus on a predictable, low-risk onramp and a clear rollback path.
Mike (Eng): yes please. MVP = installer + VPC bootstrap + simple IP preservation. Advanced BGP and tenant ejection later.
Kai (Solutions): +1. Field told me Acme expects KMS/HSM integration and a documented rollback procedure before agreeing to pilots.
Rachel (Field): Confirming Acme — their legal also needs audit logs and control-plane isolation documented. They will push if our downgrade path requires DB migration.
Anna (PM): Proposed lanes: 1) Onboard: minimal installer + docs + preflight checks. 2) Upgrade: operator-based in-place upgrades w/ canary. 3) Network: customer-managed routing primitives (NAT/BGP) as opt-in. Thoughts?
Mike (Eng): For Upgrade lane, we should require operator v1 that can pause/roll back. Implementation notes: prefer CR-based rollout with image pinning. Small snippet of acceptance criteria: 
```
- operator can perform canary (10% nodes)
- automatic rollback on probe failure (30s)
- tenant KV schema backwards compatible
```
Kai (Solutions): Could we add a preflight that outputs a deterministic risk score for IP conflicts and firewall rules? Field would use that to estimate cutover windows.
Anna (PM): Good idea — add a "network readiness" preflight check and exportable report. That stays MVP.
Rachel (Field): On rollback semantics: customer expects a documented RTO and a plan that doesn't require re-IPing services. We should state max downtime per step.
Mike (Eng): Reality: some upgrades (schema changes) may need short coordination windows. We can aim for <5m per shard for typical upgrades; longer for migrations. Will document exceptions.
Anna (PM): Decision ask for this thread: approve MVP scope = Installer + Preflight (including network readiness) + Operator v1 with canary & automatic rollback + KMS stub (documentation + integration tests), and a public rollback playbook. If approved, I'll draft launch checklist.
Kai (Solutions): Approve from solutions. I’ll draft customer onboarding template and sample playbook for Acme.
Rachel (Field): Approve from field contingent on audit-log examples being included.
Mike (Eng): Approve from eng; but note: gating item — we need sign-off on KV cache rollback logic from eng-ml. I'll create a ticket.
ops-bot: New ticket created: INF-4523 "KV cache rollback verification" assigned to eng-ml.
Anna (PM): Great — I'll add INF-4523 to the launch blockers list. Next steps: Anna to publish MVP checklist by EOD Friday, eng to estimate effort for operator rollback tests, solutions to prepare customer playbook. :thumbsup:
